svg.text: #599 Enterprise AI Data Center Cooling (Air vs. RDHx vs. Cold-Plate DLC) & 520W Power-Cap Sizer
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 20kW/45kW Rack Thermal Thresholds · PUE 1.42 → 1.11 · 520W Decode Power Cap Fits +28.5% More GPUs in 2MW
1. Three Data Center Cooling Tiers by Rack Density
Tier 1 (<= 20 kW/Rack): Hot-Aisle Containment Air Cooling (PUE = 1.42)
• Fits only 1× 8-GPU H200 node (10.2 kW) per 42U rack (75% empty rack space!)
• Stretches IB/RoCEv2 optical cable runs across 4x more racks (+$1,800/GPU cabling)
Tier 2 (20–45 kW/Rack): Rear-Door Heat Exchanger RDHx (PUE = 1.24)
• Chilled-water coil door replaces server rack rear door (Zero server chassis plumbing)
• Packs 3–4× H200 nodes/rack in existing colocation halls without raised-floor rebuild
Tier 3 (50–132 kW/Rack): Direct-to-Chip Cold-Plate DLC (PUE = 1.11)
• Captures 82% of GPU/CPU heat via 35°C–45°C warm water loop + In-Row/Row CDU
• Mandatory for GB200 NVL72 (132 kW/rack) & 4–8× H200/B200 dense superpods
2. Fitting +44.8% More GPUs Inside a Fixed 2.0 MW Hall
The Decode Power-Capping Secret (nvidia-smi -pl 520W vs. 700W TDP)
• LLM Decode is HBM memory-bandwidth bound, NOT Tensor-Core frequency bound!
• Capping H200 from 700W to 520W (-25.7% GPU power) slows Decode TPOT by only -3.2%
• Also suppresses 100μs synchronousGEMM transient current spikes (di/dt PDU trips)
• Keep Prefill/Training nodes at 650W–700W; cap Decode pools at 520W
2.0 MW Utility Power Envelope Capacity Comparison
• Air-Cooled (PUE 1.42) + Uncapped 700W H200 (10.2 kW/node): 1,104 GPUs
• Cold-Plate DLC (PUE 1.11) + Uncapped 700W H200: 1,412 GPUs (+27.9%)
• Cold-Plate DLC (PUE 1.11) + 520W Decode Power Cap: 1,680 GPUs (+52.2% More GPUs!)
• Saves $312,000/year in cooling electricity per 2 MW hall
3. Liquid Cooling Leak Prevention & CDU Redundancy Checklist
• Mandate Negative-Pressure (Sub-Atmospheric) CDU loops or dripless blind-mate QD couplings + N+1 redundant CDU pumps.
• Remember: Cold plates capture ~82% of heat; the remaining 18% (NICs, PSUs, DIMMs) still requires rear-door or room air cooling!
